title: a strict relying party refuses a sign-in without UV for a passkey made with UV; with a recent unlock Ferret's answer has UV and is accepted

unsafe.definition: the response has user verification set although nothing verified this request (no recent unlock, no PRF, PIN or master password)

note: webauthn-rs checks the UV flag against the UV of the registration (UserNotVerified). The virtual authenticator does not verify when the request does not ask; Ferret's UV after a recent unlock (UK107) is what makes this pass.
